jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Join Us in Revolutionizing Oncology Care!

At Canopy , we’re transforming healthcare for cancer patients by shifting from episodic treatment to continuous, patient-centered care. Our cutting-edge technology empowers patients to manage symptoms and access support anytime, anywhere—ensuring they never feel alone. With Canopy, the clinic is always with them .

Our innovative approach not only enhances the patient experience but also aligns clinic revenue with better health outcomes, creating a true win-win for everyone involved. By driving a 20% increase in treatment adherence and strengthening patient-provider connections, Canopy delivers life-saving results while elevating patient satisfaction to new heights.

Join us in shaping the future of oncology care! 🌿

Your Mission
As a Senior Product Manager at Canopy, you will own the strategy and execution of a large component of Canopy’s platform. You will work closely with our users to build empathy for the healthcare professionals and patients who rely on Canopy’s platform and use those insights to develop best-in-class software solutions to their most pressing problems. You will join an extraordinary team of individuals who are as driven as you are to change the face of cancer care and improve the lives of patients. Your work will directly influence how care teams engage with patients, optimize workflows, and deliver life-changing outcomes.

What You’ll Do

- Define & Execute Product Strategy – Own the vision for a major component of Canopy’s platform, translating strategy into an ambitious roadmap that maximizes impact for customers and their patients.

- Lead Discovery & Launch – Drive the full product lifecycle, from discovery to development to launch, ensuring customer needs are met iteratively and effectively.

- Engage with Users – Work directly with customers and users throughout the product lifecycle, gathering qualitative insights to inform product decisions.

- Leverage Data & Insights – Utilize Canopy’s wealth of data to enhance decision-making and optimize product outcomes.

- Collaborate Cross-Functionally – Partner with engineering, design, and customer-facing teams to build and support world-class software solutions.

What You’ll Bring

- 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager at a fast-paced, product-driven company known for innovation.

- Background in B2B software with a strong understanding of product development best practices.

- Well-developed end-to-end Product Management toolkit, including discovery, prioritization, stakeholder management, and go-to-market execution.

- Excellent communication, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills.

Bonus Points

- Direct experience in healthcare technology, specifically oncology.

- Experience working with AI-driven products.

- Background in engineering, data science, or UX design.

Benefits

💰 Competitive Compensation We offer a compelling salary and equity package to recognize and reward your contributions.

Salary: $150,000 - $230,000 USD

🩺 Comprehensive Benefits Our robust benefits package includes:

- Medical, dental, and vision coverage (select plans fully covered)

- Flexible Spending Account (FSA)

- Commuter benefits

- Life insurance

- Short- and long-term disability coverage

- 401(k) to support your financial future

🌴 Flexible PTO Recharge with our flexible PTO policy, designed to help you maintain a healthy work-life balance.

🏢 Inspiring Workspaces & Travel Perks

- Enjoy a vibrant, collaborative co-working space in Chelsea.

- Depending on your role, you may have opportunities to travel to client sites, our Tel Aviv office, or other destinations.

🌍 Hybrid & Remote Work Flexibility We embrace a hybrid/remote culture, empowering you to work from where you thrive. While we are open to remote work for the right person, NYC-based employees are expected to come into the office.

EEO Statement

Canopy is proud to be an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.
